purpose: Priority-37 acronym curation: resolve OHCHR, IACHR and M23 while preserving processes/functions/categories as non-actors.
identityRule: Acronyms are promoted only when the dossier context uniquely denotes a stable organization/institution. Review processes, mechanism functions, technology classes and population categories are rejected or deferred instead.
explicitDeferrals: NPM remains a National Preventive Mechanism function label where the dossier does not require a separate institution identity.
VSA remains a generic algorithmic/video-surveillance system class until a bounded system/deployment identity is established.
explicitNonGoals: Do not infer Rwandan sponsorship/control of M23 from identity alone.
Do not treat OHCHR/IACHR reports as ECL governance decisions.
Do not materialize UPR or LGBTI as Actors.
